scope: Generation and packaging worker visual QA only; manager visual acceptance and browser validation pending. Appearance is visual only.
styleAssessment: The normalized batch matches accepted v6a's compact head/body proportions, dark stepped contours, large eye rendering, muted clothing palette and smooth cel shading. Inspected all native generation outputs, all 160 normalized poses on dark sheets, the 20-identity overview, eight identical-scale v6a/v6b pairs, all six full-catalog inventory boards, all 20 same-band and 20 all-catalog nearest-six boards, all 80 final seated contact lines and all 20 south-facing chair proofs. No duplicate or pose-consistency concern found in worker visual QA. This remains a visual judgment for manager acceptance.
limitations: Artistic equivalence cannot be established by geometry or RMSE. The accepted v6a anchor follows recent v3/v4/v5 art; early gs018 catalog art remains grainier and is included without changing normalization.

006's targeted cane correction is slightly smoother at full native source size. At the normalized 160x320 scale its contour weight, head/body proportion and shading are consistent with v6a; manager should inspect it closely. The cane is held in anatomical left hand, hidden in true west profiles, and is visual only.

Draped garment contact positions, especially 001, 002, 006, 007 and 020, are source-bound worker estimates of support beneath the pelvis rather than hem-bottom measurements. All four directions are shown; only the approved south-facing Front Desk chair geometry has a placement proof.
Stylized faces do not prove exact ages. Intended age and compatible sex remain explicit assigned-band metadata; no clinical meaning or appearance-selection weighting was added.

Only alpha-1 native fringe noise occurs outside normalized footprints or on output borders. No protected alpha is clipped and no source pixels were repainted. Explicit manager acceptance of this exact alpha report remains pending.
Browser gallery validation is left to the manager as requested. Worker validation checks static links and PNG decoding only; no browser, game origin or campaign storage was accessed.
